beats.text: SQL or NoSQL for your next project?
beats.say: SQL or NoSQL? Which one should you pick for your next project?
SQL databases store data in tables with a fixed schema. Related data lives in separate tables, and you join it together when you query.

beats.text: NoSQL: flexible documents, no fixed schema.
beats.say: NoSQL databases store flexible documents, with no fixed schema. Everything about a user can live together in one document.
SQL gives you strong consistency, transactions, and powerful joins.
NoSQL gives you easy horizontal scaling and a flexible shape, great for huge or fast-changing data.

beats.text: Money and relationships: SQL. Scale and flexibility: NoSQL.
beats.say: So pick SQL for money and relationships. Pick NoSQL for scale and flexibility. And plenty of real systems use both.
